answer: Proposal: cap members with a fixed supply of transferable seat tokens; one seat per token; weight only for seated keys. Keypairs sprout like willow cuttings, yet an unseated key stays a relic with no weight; a million can blow in like a gale and move nothing. To dominate, an attacker must buy most seats at market price; a liquid market prices a seat near its lifetime rewards, so capture costs about the whole payout stream it could win. Assumes honest initial distribution, liquid resale. Limit: incumbents extract gatekeeping rent; if rewards outrun seat prices, defense is slow linear cost.
